title: Mack's mother sends him to Bud Hopkins

tellings.quote: And so that's how it happened is he ended up talking to Bud Hopkins

plain: A man named John Mack is said to have come to the subject of alien abduction because his mother sent him to Budd Hopkins, a man who worked with people reporting such experiences, and so "he ended up talking to Bud Hopkins." The guest Dan Sheehan tells Michels this as something he heard about how Mack, sometime in the 1980s or 90s, got drawn in.
